## Casts from STRING accept only BigQuery's canonical formats

SELECT CAST(CAST(x AS DATE) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(['2009-2-3']) AS x
=> "2009-02-03"

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS DATE) FROM UNNEST(['2009-02-13 ']) AS x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS DATE) FROM UNNEST(['998-02-13']) AS x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS DATE) FROM UNNEST(['2009/02/13']) AS x
=> null

SELECT CAST(x AS DATE) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS STRING)]) AS x
=> null

SELECT CAST(CAST(x AS TIME) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(['12:34:56.123456']) AS x
=> "12:34:56.123456"

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS TIME) FROM UNNEST(['12:34:56.123456+08:00']) AS x
=> null

SELECT CAST(CAST(x AS DATETIME) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(['2006-01-02T12:34:56']) AS x
=> "2006-01-02 12:34:56"

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS DATETIME) FROM UNNEST([' 2006-01-02 12:34:56.123456 ']) AS x
=> null

SELECT CAST(CAST(x AS TIMESTAMP) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(['2009-02-13 23:31:30+09']) AS x
=> "2009-02-13 14:31:30+00"

SELECT CAST(CAST(x AS TIMESTAMP) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(['2009-02-13T23:31:30Z']) AS x
=> "2009-02-13 23:31:30+00"

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS TIMESTAMP) FROM UNNEST(['10000-01-01 00:00:00']) AS x
=> null

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(CAST(CAST(x AS ARRAY<DATE>) AS ARRAY<STRING>), ',')
FROM UNNEST([['2009-02-13', '2009-2-14']]) AS x
=> "2009-02-13,2009-02-14"

## Casts to STRING format as BigQuery does

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([CAST(0 AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> "0"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([CAST(123 AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> "123"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([0.1 + 0.2]) AS x
=> "0.30000000000000004"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> "nan"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.12345']) AS x
=> "01:02:03.123450"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03']) AS x
=> "01:02:03"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([DATETIME '2006-01-02 03:04:05.12345']) AS x
=> "2006-01-02 03:04:05.123450"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIMESTAMP '2006-01-02 03:04:05.12345+00']) AS x
=> "2006-01-02 03:04:05.123450+00"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP)]) AS x
=> null

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(CAST(x AS ARRAY<STRING>), ',') FROM UNNEST([[1.5, 2.0]]) AS x
=> "1.5,2"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRUCT<s STRING>).s FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(NUMERIC '1.50' AS n)]) AS x
=> "1.5"
